metadata.name: carpenter_amm
metadata.description: FLOOR on Solana: the v4-shaped AMM with approved hooks

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not the required authority

errors.name: HookNotExecutable
errors.msg: hook program is not an executable loader-v3 program

errors.name: HookFlagsInvalid
errors.msg: hook flags fail v4's isValidHookAddress rules or the Solana additions

errors.name: RoundsTooHigh
errors.msg: max_rounds exceeds MAX_ROUNDS_CAP

errors.name: HookHeaderMismatch
errors.msg: approve_hook args disagree with the hook's interface header

errors.name: HookNotApproved
errors.msg: hook is not approved

errors.name: HookPausedForNewPools
errors.msg: hook is paused for new pools

errors.name: HookUpgradedReapprove
errors.msg: hook ProgramData slot differs from the approval: re-approve

errors.name: CurrenciesOutOfOrder
errors.msg: mint0 must sort below mint1

errors.name: TickSpacingInvalid
errors.msg: tick spacing out of range

errors.name: FeeInvalid
errors.msg: fee out of range, or the fee/hook combination is invalid

errors.name: MintNotSupported
errors.msg: mint is not supported

errors.name: MintExclusive
errors.msg: mint is exclusive to another hook

errors.name: SeedsMismatch
errors.msg: account does not match its PDA seeds

errors.name: TickArrayStartInvalid
errors.msg: tick array start index is not aligned or out of bounds

errors.name: TickInvalid
errors.msg: tick is not aligned to the spacing or is out of bounds

errors.name: PositionRangeLocked
errors.msg: a position's range may change only while its liquidity is zero

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: slippage limit exceeded

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: insufficient liquidity

errors.name: PositionNotEmpty
errors.msg: position still holds liquidity

errors.name: HookBadReturn
errors.msg: hook return data is missing, from the wrong program, undecodable or not an echo

errors.name: HookFieldNotAllowed
errors.msg: hook record sets a field its phase or flags do not allow

errors.name: HookDeltaExceedsSwapAmount
errors.msg: hook delta flips the specified amount

errors.name: HookDeltaExceedsSwapOutput
errors.msg: hook delta flips the trader's side

errors.name: HookActionAccountMissing
errors.msg: hook action needs an account the transaction did not supply

errors.name: HookClaimsInsufficient
errors.msg: hook claims do not cover the debit

errors.name: HookRoundsExceeded
errors.msg: hook asked for a callback beyond max_rounds

errors.name: HookDeltaNegative
errors.msg: negative hook deltas are not supported in v1

errors.name: HookSliceAliasesAmmAccount
errors.msg: hook slice contains one of the AMM's own accounts

errors.name: TickArrayMissing
errors.msg: a needed tick array was not supplied

errors.name: PriceLimitInvalid
errors.msg: price limit is on the wrong side of the current price

errors.name: AmountZero
errors.msg: amount is zero

errors.name: InvalidFeeForExactOut
errors.msg: a fee of 100% cannot quote exact output

errors.name: NoLiquidity
errors.msg: pool liquidity is below MIN_DONATE_LIQUIDITY

errors.name: DonateTooLarge
errors.msg: donation exceeds u64::MAX / 2

errors.name: NoHook
errors.msg: pool has no hook

errors.name: CurrencyInvalid
errors.msg: currency must be 0 or 1

errors.name: VaultMismatch
errors.msg: vault does not belong to the pool for that currency

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: mint does not belong to the pool for that currency

errors.name: TokenProgramMismatch
errors.msg: token program does not belong to the pool for that currency

errors.name: NotHookAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the hook authority

errors.name: ExclusivityNotAllowed
errors.msg: hook is not allowed to register mint exclusivity

errors.name: ExclusivityQuoteMint
errors.msg: a quote mint cannot be made exclusive

errors.name: MintAlreadyPooled
errors.msg: mint already has a pool

errors.name: NotDynamicFee
errors.msg: pool fee is not dynamic

errors.name: DelegateMissing
errors.msg: token account has CPI Guard and no sufficient delegation to the pool

errors.name: VaultConservationViolated
errors.msg: vault balance does not equal its booked movement, or claims exceed it

errors.name: DuplicateTickArray
errors.msg: duplicate key in the tick-array set

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: HookSliceLengthMismatch
errors.msg: hook slice length is not pool.hook_callback_accounts

errors.name: HookDataTooLong
errors.msg: hook_data exceeds MAX_HOOK_DATA

errors.name: PositionIdNotSigned
errors.msg: creating a position needs its position_id to sign

errors.name: PositionNotTransferable
errors.msg: a hook's own position cannot be transferred

errors.name: PositionTransferInvalid
errors.msg: new owner is the zero address or the current owner

errors.name: HookFeesInconsistent
errors.msg: hook fee split claims more than its delta, or a platform cut above the skim

errors.name: PoolPaused
errors.msg: pool is paused: swaps, adds, donations and deposits are refused; removals and withdrawals are not

errors.name: VaultShortfall
errors.msg: vault holds less than the claims booked against it

errors.name: QuoteMintNotListed
errors.msg: quote roster entry is absent, or present and not Listed

errors.name: QuoteMintRetired
errors.msg: quote mint is retired: no new pool may open with it in the quote slot

errors.name: QuoteMintAlreadyListed
errors.msg: quote mint is already on the roster

errors.name: QuoteMintPooled
errors.msg: quote mint still has pools: retire it instead of delisting it

errors.name: QuoteMintImplied
errors.msg: wSOL is the implied quote and cannot be rostered

errors.name: QuoteMintNotRetired
errors.msg: quote roster entry is not retired: only a retired entry can be relisted

errors.name: VaultFrozenAtCreation
errors.msg: vault was created frozen (DefaultAccountState); no pool is opened

errors.name: QuoteHookArmed
errors.msg: mint's transfer hook has been ARMED since the pool opened; the pool is halted

errors.name: QuotePaused
errors.msg: mint is paused by its issuer; no transfer can settle

errors.name: QuoteFeeArmed
errors.msg: mint carries a live transfer fee; sent would not equal received

errors.name: MintNotSupportedAsBase
errors.msg: mint carries a custodial capability and may only be a LISTED QUOTE, never a base mint

errors.name: QuoteCapsNotAdmitted
errors.msg: a capability of this quote mint is not admitted by AmmConfig.quote_caps_admitted (set_quote_caps_admitted)

errors.name: QuoteCapsInvalid
errors.msg: the admission mask may name only the Tier-B (custodial) capability bits

errors.name: BalanceAtOrBelowKeep
errors.msg: trader_token_in holds no more than keep: nothing to spend (swap_from_balance)

errors.name: BalanceSwapNotOwner
errors.msg: trader_token_in is not owned by the trader: swap_from_balance spends only the signer's own account

errors.name: BalanceSwapSelfCall
errors.msg: a hook-authority swap settles against claims and has no balance to spend

errors.name: BalanceSwapPartialFill
errors.msg: swap_from_balance did not spend its whole resolved input (price limit or liquidity reached)

errors.name: TransferHookNotAdmitted
errors.msg: mint's armed transfer hook is not the program this pool admits on its base side, or its authority is live

errors.name: BaseTransferHookAlreadySet
errors.msg: ApprovedHook.base_transfer_hook is already set; it is set once

errors.name: BadBaseTransferHook
errors.msg: not a transfer-hook program the AMM can admit (zero, the AMM, or a token program)

errors.name: TransferHookAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a transfer of a hooked mint is missing the transfer hook's accounts (its extra-account-metas list, the program, or an entry)

errors.name: TickArrayNotEmpty
errors.msg: tick array still counts an initialized tick

errors.name: TickArrayNotZeroed
errors.msg: tick array's ticks are not all zero bytes

errors.name: TickArrayBitmapBitSet
errors.msg: the pool's bitmap still marks this tick array

errors.name: ProtocolFeeTooLarge
errors.msg: protocol fee above MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE (1,000 pips = 0.1% per direction)

errors.name: WrongDestination
errors.msg: destination is not the protocol treasury's token account for this mint (sweep), or is the treasury's own (withdraw)

errors.name: NotTreasuryAccount
errors.msg: source is not a token account the protocol treasury owns

errors.name: TreasuryBalanceShort
errors.msg: withdraw exceeds the treasury account's balance

errors.name: BadTreasuryGovernance
errors.msg: not a key the protocol treasury can be governed by (zero, or the treasury itself)

errors.name: GuardianPauseRunning
errors.msg: a guardian pause is already running here; the guardian cannot extend it

errors.name: GuardianCoolOff
errors.msg: inside the guardian's cool-off after its last pause of this pool / hook

errors.name: HookQuotesNotAllowed
errors.msg: this approved hook may not list quote mints (ApprovedHook.allow_hook_quotes is 0)

errors.name: HookSettleSignerMissing
errors.msg: a settling hook's slice must start with the ["hook_settle", pool] PDA

errors.name: HookSettleVaultDecreased
errors.msg: a settling hook lowered a vault balance

errors.name: HookSettleOverfill
errors.msg: a settling hook took more than the unfilled remainder of an exact-in
